offer.text: I'm farther from home than I've ever been, and I don't mind telling you I'm afraid. Guard me and I'll lead us back, however long the road.

accept.text: Thank you. Keep your eyes on the treeline and I'll keep us moving.

decline.text: Then I'm truly on my own out here. Heaven help me.

in_progress.text: Still a long way yet. Don't let them flank us.

ready.text: I never thought I'd see those walls again. We did it!

complete.text: You brought me back from the far wilds. I owe you my life, plainly.

failed.text: It was too far, too dark... I lost everything out there but my skin. Give me time.
